title: Trainer Tasks unlock only inside their season day window
summary: No game data changed in this version: no config tables, no text, and no new art. Two client scripts were changed. Trainer Tasks now unlock only while the current season's open-day count falls inside the day window configured for that task group, where previously a matching season number alone was enough, and the Challenge Dojo opponent list stops reading rank data for a badge tier it has not loaded.
highlights: Trainer Tasks: unlocking now also requires the task group to belong to the current season's group range and the season's open days to fall inside that group's configured day window, not just a matching season number.
Trainer Tasks: if the season has no task groups at all, the tasks now stay locked rather than unlocking on a season-number match.
Trainer Tasks: the unlock check builds the task group table on demand if missing, the season group range returns an empty range instead of reading a missing table, and the server id falls back to 0.
Trainer Tasks: the group completion check now confirms the requested group exists before iterating it.
Challenge Dojo: the opponent list accessors, the load-more check and the list refresh now return early when the selected badge tier has no rank data loaded, instead of indexing straight into it.
Challenge Dojo: the opponent list now refreshes only on a player-info response for the badge tier it requested, so a response for another tier no longer repaints the list.
